purpose: Ship AgentWeave 1.0.0 to master and publish it. AgentWeave is ONE product with ONE version from this release on: the separate `agentweave-hub` version line and the `hub-v*` tag scheme retire, `pip install agentweave-ai` becomes a working product on its own, and the documentation and README describe the thing that actually exists rather than the multi-runtime product that was deleted. Fix everything that stands in the way of that, merge to master, tag, release.
